label: Characterization of post-acute multi-organ sequelae following SARS-CoV-2 Infection in the Delta and Omicron Eras in a highly boosted population.
summary: Multi-organ post-acute sequelae of severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) infection (PASC) is extensively documented. Recent studies in predominantly Caucasian populations suggest that the evolution of SARS-CoV-2 variants can influence risk (as measured by hazard ratios) and rates (as measured by incidence rate ratios) of PASC, and they also highlight the protective effects of COVID-19 vaccination.
